create_FromTransitions: create a FromTransitions dataclass to configure n-step transition learning with a custom step count
create_FromSequences: create a FromSequences dataclass to configure sequence learning with custom length and td_lambda
create_GaussianPolicyLossConfig: create a GaussianPolicyLossConfig to configure continuous policy loss with custom epsilon and temperature
create_CategoricalPolicyLossConfig: create a CategoricalPolicyLossConfig to configure discrete policy loss with custom epsilon and alpha
create_LossScalesConfig: create a LossScalesConfig to scale policy and critic losses with optional rollout scaling
